title: Books, bath products and me time!
text: This was my third box and I can’t wait for the next! Being surprised with bath bombs and artisanal soaps, candles, body scrubs and bubble baths is so much fun. Then of course there is the book - awesome to discover new authors. I like that most of the products seem to be from small-independent business owners. Supporting small business is a priority for me. Highly recommend this box.
label: positive
